body.name: aggregate-projector, positive-moment, and local-score handle
body.construction: For positive-law repair, start from Bauer--Fike localization of the empirical compressed operator, replace individual eigenvectors inside overlapping discs by Kato contour projectors, transport aggregate projector mass only across each cluster diameter, and project the finite summary onto the positive \(k\)-atomic moment cone before extracting a real probability measure. For the labeled-weight converse, differentiate the Bernoulli factorization of \(P_{\varepsilon}^{\mathrm{wit}}\) and solve the linear score-cancellation equations for proxy and treatment primitives so that a weight displacement \(h\) preserves the factorization while the observed score has order \(g h\).
